headline: 2026 FIFA World Cup Opens June 11 in Mexico City
deck: First 48-team tournament spans three nations with opening ceremony featuring global music stars at Estadio Azteca.
summary: The 2026 FIFA World Cup kicks off June 11, 2026, at Mexico City Stadium (Estadio Azteca) with an opening ceremony beginning 90 minutes before the first match at 11:30 local time. The tournament marks a historic expansion to 48 teams and will feature 104 matches across 16 host cities in Mexico, the United States, and Canada. Global music stars including J Balvin, Maná, Tyla, and Alejandro Fernández will headline the opening ceremony performance.
